watchers.script:
let total_qty = 0
let total_amount = 0
billingItems.value.forEach(item => {
    total_qty += item.qty
	total_amount += item.standard_rate * item.qty
	item.amount = item.standard_rate * item.qty
})
totalQty.value = total_qty
totalAmount.value = total_amount
